import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int trg;
        long cost;
        long adjcost;
        long flow;
        long cap;
        int dual;

        Edge() {}

        Edge(int t, long c, long cp, int d) {
            trg = t;
            cost = c;
            adjcost = c;
            flow = 0;
            cap = cp;
            dual = d;
        }
    }

    static class Node {
        List<Edge> edges;

        Node() {
            edges = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static class GraphBase {
        List<Node> nodes;

        int size() {
            return nodes.size();
        }

        int size(int id) {
            return nodes.get(id).edges.size();
        }

        Node get(int id) {
            return nodes.get(id);
        }

        GraphBase(int sz) {
            nodes = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < sz; i++) {
                nodes.add(new Node());
            }
        }
    }

    static class MCMFGraph extends GraphBase {
        static class PQItem implements Comparable<PQItem> {
            int trg;
            long prio;

            PQItem(int t, long p) {
                trg = t;
                prio = p;
            }

            @Override
            public int compareTo(PQItem b) {
                return Long.compare(prio, b.prio);
            }
        }

        MCMFGraph(int sz) {
            super(sz);
        }

        void add(int a, int b, long cost, long cap, long rcap) {
            if (a == b) return;
            if (cap > 0 && rcap > 0) {
                add(a, b, cost, cap, 0);
                add(b, a, cost, cap, 0);
            } else if (rcap > 0) {
                add(b, a, cost, rcap, 0);
            } else {
                int da = size(a);
                int db = size(b);
                nodes.get(a).edges.add(new Edge(b, cost, cap, db));
                nodes.get(b).edges.add(new Edge(a, -cost, 0, da));
            }
        }

        long[] augment(int source, int sink) {
            int N = size();
            long big = Long.MAX_VALUE;

            long[] upby = new long[N];
            long[] prio = new long[N];
            int[] preve = new int[N];
            PriorityQueue<PQItem> q = new PriorityQueue<>();

            Arrays.fill(prio, big);
            prio[source] = 0;
            upby[source] = big;
            q.add(new PQItem(source, 0));

            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                PQItem item = q.poll();
                int cur = item.trg;
                long p = item.prio;
                if (p != prio[cur]) continue;
                
                for (int i = 0; i < size(cur); i++) {
                    Edge e = nodes.get(cur).edges.get(i);
                    long p2 = p + e.adjcost;
                    if (e.flow < e.cap && p2 < prio[e.trg]) {
                        prio[e.trg] = p2;
                        preve[e.trg] = e.dual;
                        upby[e.trg] = Math.min(e.cap - e.flow, upby[cur]);
                        q.add(new PQItem(e.trg, p2));
                    }
                }
            }

            long up = upby[sink];
            long upcost = 0;
            if (up > 0) {
                int cur = sink;
                while (cur != source) {
                    Edge ed = nodes.get(cur).edges.get(preve[cur]);
                    Edge e = nodes.get(ed.trg).edges.get(ed.dual);
                    e.flow += up;
                    upcost += e.cost * up;
                    ed.flow -= up;
                    cur = ed.trg;
                }

                for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < size(i); j++) {
                        Edge e = nodes.get(i).edges.get(j);
                        e.adjcost += prio[i] - prio[e.trg];
                    }
                }
            }
            return new long[]{up, upcost};
        }

        long[] make_flow(int source, int sink) {
            for (int i = 0; i < size(); i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < size(i); j++) {
                    Edge e = nodes.get(i).edges.get(j);
                    e.flow = 0;
                    e.adjcost = e.cost;
                }
            }

            long flow = 0;
            long cost = 0;
            while (true) {
                long[] up = augment(source, sink);
                if (up[0] == 0) break;
                flow += up[0];
                cost += up[1];
            }
            return new long[]{flow, cost};
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int N = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int M = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int K = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int C = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int D = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int[] a = new int[K];
        int[] starts = new int[N];

        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
            a[i] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            starts[a[i]]++;
        }

        int maxT = K + N + 1;
        int V = (maxT + 1) * N + 2;
        int src = V - 2;
        int sink = V - 1;
        MCMFGraph g = new MCMFGraph(V);

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            if (starts[i] > 0) {
                g.add(src, i, 0, starts[i], 0);
            }
        }

        for (int t = 0; t <= maxT; t++) {
            g.add(t * N, sink, 0, K, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int t = 0; t < maxT; t++) {
                g.add(t * N + i, (t + 1) * N + i, C, K, 0);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int u = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            int v = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            for (int t = 0; t < maxT; t++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
                    g.add(t * N + u, (t + 1) * N + v, C + (2L * j + 1) * D, 1, 0);
                    g.add(t * N + v, (t + 1) * N + u, C + (2L * j + 1) * D, 1, 0);
                }
            }
        }

        long[] fc = g.make_flow(src, sink);
        System.out.println(fc[1]);
    }
}
